recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If orphaned Observation relationship value set source is cleaned later, do that under a separate build-scope cleanup rather than as a current-spec fix for FHIR-3468.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 issue requesting removal of the old tools-extensions profile and migration of equivalent extension definitions to resource-specific extension profiles.
initial_application: Git commit 477bf0fd630c8209b337e82af8bd86c8c6e7b2fc, matching svn revision 3250, removed the tools-extensions entry from source/fhir.ini, deleted profiles/tools-extensions.xml, and added or updated resource-specific extension spreadsheet sources for Profile, ValueSet, and OperationOutcome.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini lists active extension profiles without tools-extensions. Current source search found only source/observation/valueset-observation-relationshiptypes.xml still using tools-extensions#definition; no fhir.ini/source references were found for that value set and build.fhir.org has no corresponding value set page. The replacement valueset-concept-definition extension is present in the FHIR Extension Pack and is already used elsewhere in current core source.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the requested removal/migration was already applied and no current built core source needs correction for FHIR-3468.
